content:
Priya (Recruiter): Heads-up thread: internal candidate Samir Patel (currently T2 IC) has an external counteroffer but prefers to stay if we can match parity for his new role (T3). He requested a retention bonus paid out over 12 months and ability to carry over 10 vacation days from current role. Wants to start in 3 weeks. Can we approve an internal transfer with a temporary retention structure? cc @Omar

Omar (Hiring Manager): Samir is the only IC with the infra-to-data experience we need for the migration. Losing him will push our timeline and force contractor spend. I can reallocate budget to cover partial retention. Prefer a structured retention bonus rather than an immediate base uplift to avoid changing banding precedent.

Aisha (People Ops): Policy options: 1) permanent band elevation to T3 (requires committee if >+8% base), 2) internal lateral with retention bonus (one-time or staggered) that doesn't change banding. For a quick decision the retention bonus path is preferable. Need manager justification, comp sign-off on amounts and whether carryover PTO allowed, payroll on payment cadence, finance on funding source, and legal on the repayment/clawback if he leaves early.

Nora (Comp & Benefits): We can approve a retention bonus up to 12% of target base paid monthly over 12 months without permanent band change. PTO carryover is manager- and payroll-approve only; no policy block but must be documented. If you want permanent band upgrade now, that needs formal comp committee review. 

Priya (Recruiter): Candidate wants cash spread (monthly) to avoid tax shock and keep his current total comp intact. He said base uplift feels risky for internal equity. He also asked for the 10-day PTO carryover and day-1 benefits eligibility for medical.

Leah (Payroll): For monthly retention installments we can process through payroll as taxable supplemental pay. Carryover of 10 days can be granted if current manager approves and we document the transfer. Day-1 benefits: internal transfers typically keep benefits continuous if no more than a 7-day gap; confirm start date to avoid gap.

Vik (Finance): Funding check: hiring/ops contingency can cover up to $18k this quarter for retention bonuses. Any above needs VP Finance approval. Please provide exact numbers so we can confirm capacity.

Aisha (People Ops): OK clear path to close today if we do retention bonus: 
- Omar: paste 1-2 sentence manager justification explaining retention vs uplift.
- Nora: confirm exact retention %/amount.
- Vik: ACK funding for the amount.
- Leah: confirm payroll cadence and carryover acceptance.
- Sam: draft a simple repayment/clawback clause for monthly installments if Samir leaves within 12 months.
- Priya: send revised internal transfer letter for signature.

Omar (Hiring Manager): Justification: Samirs knowledge of both infra and analytics prevents a 2-month rework. A retention bonus spreads cost, preserves internal banding, and avoids contractor ramp.

Nora (Comp & Benefits): approve retention bonus: 10% of base paid in 12 equal monthly installments. For Samir that equates to $9,600 over 12 months on a $96,000 base. No permanent band change today. Approve 10-day PTO carryover pending current manager sign-off. Day-1 benefits OK if transfer start date has <=7 day gap.

Vik (Finance): ACK funding: $9,600 covered from hiring contingency. No VP sign-off needed.

Leah (Payroll): Payroll confirms monthly installments processed through payroll beginning first full month after start. We will require current PTO audit and a manager sign-off email to allow 10-day carryover. Benefits continuity confirmed if start date chosen to avoid >7 day gap.

Sam (Legal): Draft clawback: "If the employee voluntarily separates prior to 12 months from the first retention installment, the employee will repay a prorated portion of any unpaid/advanced retention installments equal to the remaining months. Repayment terms to be documented in the transfer agreement." Will insert into the letter.

Priya (Recruiter): Sending internal transfer letter with retention schedule, clawback clause, PTO carryover note, and recommended start date that keeps benefits continuous. Samir verbally accepts these terms; will e-sign once he sees the letter. Posting signed doc here when done. Thanks everyone :tada:
